answer: When a panel's verdicts on one submitter spread by more than 3 points the case is escalated to a second panel rather than settled, and a repeated pattern flags the submitter for audit. The spiral record keeps the spread, terrace schedules the escalation, and ocean publishes the outcome. A farm cannot rely on staffing its own jurors because a suspiciously unanimous panel is itself the tell. A 192 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
